AlertBase.description:
The district's own record: it closed or went remote on about ``points`` in 100 of its
recorded days with ``alert`` (the days the archive read, never every alert issued).

borrowed.description: The day's own weather has too few recorded days: the chance is counted over the recorded days with alert instead, and the sentence says so.

live.description: The days counted are days the live pipeline read (complete daily reads), not the recorded archive days; the sentence says so.

AlertBase.title: AlertBase

AlertKind.description: The weather alert a district's base chance is counted over.

Base.description: Where the chance starts, before any reason.

ChanceOfNoSchool.description: A chance of no school, from 0.01 to 0.99 in hundredths: never a certainty, so how it adds up always has whole points to show.

ColdReason.description: It feels like ``feels_like`` at the bus stop that morning: it only adds points.
ColdReason.title: ColdReason

CountedWeather.description: The weather of the days a base counts, for a class whose alerts have no one alert kind: advisory (winter weather, freezing rain and lake effect snow advisories), cold (extreme cold and wind chill warnings), lake_snow (lake effect snow warnings), tropical (hurricane and tropical storm warnings).

DayAfterBase.description:
The district's own record: after a recorded snow day, it stayed closed or went remote
the next day on about ``points`` in 100 of those recorded days.

live.description: The days counted are days the live pipeline read (complete daily reads), not the recorded archive days; the sentence says so.

DayAfterBase.title: DayAfterBase

DayForecast.description: One district's outlook for one day.

DirectoryStamp.description:
The directory a file's school and district indexes point into.

It must equal generated_on, count and the number of districts of the
schools/meta.json the reader has loaded; otherwise the file is ignored.
DirectoryStamp.title: DirectoryStamp

DistrictForecast.description: One district's outlook for each day in the file's days.

neighbors.description: The districts next door, nearest first: every other district with a school within 10 miles of one of this district's schools.

DistrictForecast.title: DistrictForecast

DistrictIndex.description: A district's position in schools/meta.json districts.ids.

Fahrenheit.description: How cold or warm it feels, in whole degrees F.

Forecast.description: A school day's chance of no school or a delay, with the weather forecast, if any.

announces_at.description: When the district usually posts its decision for this day: that day or the evening before, in the district's time zone, and before buses_at.

buses_at.description: When the district's first buses usually run that day: on the day, in the district's time zone.

reasons.description: The forecast weather, most important first; empty when none is forecast. Always written, even empty (no default): the web reader before the compact file refuses a whole file whose forecast has no reasons list.

why.description: How the chance adds up: always given with a forecast.

Forecast.title: Forecast

HourSpan.description: Hours of an hourly series, by position: first to last, both included.
HourSpan.title: HourSpan

Hours.description:
One weather measure, an hour at a time from ``start`` to the bus hour, for the chart.

``snow_total``: the snow on the ground since the storm began, in inches, at each
hour (snow that fell before ``start`` included, so the first value may be above 0);
``low`` and ``high`` bound it at the bus hour; ``heavy`` marks the hours the snow
falls fastest (value i is the snow on the ground at ``start`` + i hours, so the
heaviest snow falls from ``start`` + (first - 1) hours to ``start`` + last hours).
``wind_chill``: how cold it will feel each hour, in degrees F; no range, no heavy hours.

start.description: The first value's hour, on the hour.

values.description: One value an hour, in tenths: inches of snow on the ground since the storm began, or degrees F.

Hours.title: Hours

IceReason.description: Freezing rain leaves ``inches`` of ice on the roads: it only adds points.
IceReason.title: IceReason

IcyRoadsReason.description: Side streets stay icy after ``inches`` of snow: it only adds points.
IcyRoadsReason.title: IcyRoadsReason

Inches.description: Inches of snow or ice, in tenths (6.5, not 6.53).

LocalDate.description: A calendar day in the school's own time zone: YYYY-MM-DD.

NeighborsReason.description:
Districts next door (the entry's ``neighbors``) that already posted ``status``.

A closing or a remote day next door only ever adds points.
NeighborsReason.title: NeighborsReason

NoThreat.description:
A day that is not a school day: a weekend, Thanksgiving Thursday and Friday, or 24
December to 1 January.
NoThreat.title: NoThreat

OutlookIndex.description: A day's outlook, as its position in the file's outlooks.

PastDay.description: One day in the district's record: its snow and what the district did.

status.description: What the district did; null when it opened.

PastDay.title: PastDay

PastRecord.description:
The district's own record in days like this one, oldest first.

``proves`` names the line it sits under: ``base`` (the base chance) or a reason's
kind. ``inches`` is the least snow of a storm counted as similar, or null when the
days are not storms (the days after one, say).
PastRecord.title: PastRecord

Points.description: Whole percentage points a reason adds to the chance, or below 0 takes away.

PooledBase.description:
For a district with too short a history of its own: the districts around it.

The districts of ``scope`` (``nearby``: within the neighbor distance; the
district's county, state or weather region; or ``nation``: the districts of every
state, named when no smaller place's record is true of the chance) closed or went
remote on about ``points`` in 100 of their recorded district-days like this one, or
with ``alert`` when one is given, or of ``weather`` when that is given. The pipeline
names a scope only when the share the website says for ``points`` is true of that
scope's recorded days.

``of`` says whose days are counted: ``districts``, or ``private_schools`` (a private
school's chance is counted over private schools' recorded days only: "Private schools
near St. Ann closed ...").

borrowed.description: The day's own weather (or the day after a snow day) has too few recorded days: the chance is counted over the recorded days with alert, or, with no alert, the days like this that did not follow a recorded snow day; the sentence says so.

live.description: The days counted are days the live pipeline read (complete daily reads), not the recorded archive days; the sentence says so.

of.description: Whose recorded days are counted: districts', or private schools' only.

weather.description: With no alert: the weather of the days counted, when they are days with an alert of a class that has no one alert kind; null for days with no winter alert.

PooledBase.title: PooledBase

PreviousChance.description: The chance of no school the run before this one gave the same district and day.
PreviousChance.title: PreviousChance

Probability.description: A chance from 0 to 1, in hundredths (0.07, not 0.0734).

Reason.description:
The weather named for a status or a forecast.

0 winter storm, 1 ice, 2 extreme cold, 3 flooding, 4 hurricane,
5 severe storms, 6 heat, 7 power outage.
Reason.title: Reason

ReasonPoints.description: One reason, of a kind, and the points it adds.

RecordReason.description: The district's own record in storms like this one (the file's ``record``).
RecordReason.title: RecordReason

SaidOpenReason.description:
The district (every one of its eligible schools, as a statement it posted for all of
them reaches) or the private school said school is on for the day: it takes the chance
down to the floor, so it only takes points away.
SaidOpenReason.title: SaidOpenReason

SchemaVersion.description: The file format's version. A reader refuses a file with any other.

SchoolForecast.description:
One private school's outlook for each day in the file's days (contract C3): a school
with no district gets its own chance, counted over private schools.

Its ``days`` name each day's outlook by its position in the file's ``outlooks``, and its
``zone`` its time zone by its position in the file's ``zones``: many private schools share
the same outlook and the same zone, so the file holds each once.

neighbors.description: The districts next door, nearest first: districts with a school within 10 miles of this school.

SchoolForecast.title: SchoolForecast

SchoolIndex.description: A school's position in schools/meta.json ids (and in points.bin).

SimilarDaysBase.description:
The district's own record: it closed or went remote on about ``points`` in 100 of its
recorded days like this one (same weather class), named by ``weather`` when the class
has an alert of its own ("recorded winter advisory days").

borrowed.description: The day follows a snow day and too few such days are recorded: the chance is counted over the recorded days like this that did not follow a recorded snow day.

live.description: The days counted are days the live pipeline read (complete daily reads), not the recorded archive days; the sentence says so.

weather.description: The weather of the days counted, when they are days with an alert of a class that has no one alert kind; null for days with no winter alert.

SimilarDaysBase.title: SimilarDaysBase

SnowStopsReason.description: The snow stops (or stopped) at ``at``: before the buses, it only takes points away.
SnowStopsReason.title: SnowStopsReason

SnowTotalReason.description: How much snow is coming: ``low`` to ``high`` inches, overnight or not.
SnowTotalReason.title: SnowTotalReason

Status.description:
What a school is doing on a day because of weather.

0 closed, 1 delayed start, 2 remote or e-learning, 3 early dismissal.
Status.title: Status

SunReason.description: Sun the afternoon before helps melt the ice: it only takes points away.
SunReason.title: SunReason

TimeZoneName.description: An IANA time zone: every local day and wall-clock time of the district.

TimingReason.description: When the heaviest snow falls, against when the buses run.
TimingReason.title: TimingReason

UtcInstant.description: A moment in UTC, whole seconds: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

WeatherEvent.description: Weather that already happened, with its time.

Why.description: How the chance adds up: the base, then each reason's points, biggest first.
Why.title: Why

WindChillReason.description: The wind makes it feel like ``feels_like`` at the bus stop: it only adds points.
WindChillReason.title: WindChillReason

ZoneIndex.description: A time zone, as its position in the file's zones.

description:
predictions/latest.json: per district, and per private school, the chance of no school
or a delay, by day.

days.description: The local days forecast, consecutive, today first.

outlooks.description: Each distinct outlook the schools' days name, once; every one is named.

schools.description: The private schools (no district), sorted by school, each once.

zones.description: Each distinct time zone the schools name, once; every one is named.
